findings.title: strings.json holds 6 false rows: five user-facing claims contradict the production symbol that decides them
findings.claim: In the tree under test, six strings.json sentences are contradicted by the production code deciding them: loose birch is not 0.60 of packed (wood_fuel), a flow sensor in L/min is read at 1/60 of its value (const.FLOW_UNIT_TO_KG_S), a fresh-water station carries 150 L of potable water not 0 (const.COMBI_TANK_PRESETS), Observe duty mode reaches the pump write (pump_arbiter._arbitrate), and the return-target off gate is 30 degC not 20 degC (pump_arbiter._gate_floor_c, two sentences).
findings.mechanism: The text states the shipped behaviour; the production symbol each sentence describes delivers a different value. Per row (ledger.tsv, verdict false): #538b900c1b wood_packing (birch loose/packed=1.667, pine and mixed 0.600); #25d4327206 flow units (FLOW_UNIT_TO_KG_S['L/min']=0.998/3600, so 10 L/min x 5 K reads 0.058 kW instead of 3.48 kW); #60b9412b58 '0 for a fresh-water station' (external_station potable_volume_l=150.0); #b6c5358b63 'Observe writes none either' (one _command, one _adopt and one night-schedule write per observe pass); #3102a60501 and #7a9d1fff5d '20 degC for a return target' (_as_target adds RETURN_SUPPLY_OFFSET_K for a return unit, so _gate_floor_c returns 30.0 and the W35 hold 40.0).

leads.what: birch packed 1140 / loose 1900 kWh/m3, inverted against pine and mixed (loose = 0.60 x packed); a packed-birch m3 is priced 1.67x dearer per kWh in wood_sek_per_kwh and the cheaper-than-pump rule. Probe: probes.py --probe wood_packing_ratio.
0.998/3600 kg/s per L/min (the L/h factor); a flow meter in L/min yields 1/60 of the delivered heat (10 L/min x 5 K -> 0.058 kW, physical 3.48). Probe: probes.py --probe flow_unit_lmin.

potable_volume_l 150.0 though its own comment says a plate exchanger stores none; adds 150 L to buffer_store_volume and lifts the station above COMBI_LEGIONELLA_POTABLE_LIMIT_L so the legionella cycle runs. Probe: probes.py --probe station_potable.

in duty mode observe the pass continues past the off block to _adopt, _command and _write_night_schedule (only _pump_off guards it); observe writes to the pump. Probe: probes.py --probe observe_writes.
adds RETURN_SUPPLY_OFFSET_K for a return-water target instead of subtracting; off gate 30 degC (docstring and UI: 20), W35 hold written as 40. Probe: probes.py --probe return_gate.
